source_law.title: Stopping, standing or parking prohibited in specified places (1)(k)
source_law.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Alongside or opposite any highway excavation or obstruction when stopping, standing or parking would obstruct traffic.

legal_analysis_note: The 11 selected cases cover parking, stop, stand, alongside/opposite placement and source-gated traffic-conflict, law-direction, police-direction and device-direction requests. Physical-obstruction cases measure spawned barrier bodies, not an actual excavation. Excavation-kind remains an unselected lowered-surface construction proposal requiring Native readback and source review. No statutory width or delay cutoff or legal result is inferred from engineering measurements.
physical_prerequisites: Place actual highway excavation or obstruction and verify alongside/opposite geometry plus measured obstruction to traffic during a stop/stand/park.
legal_interpretation_limit: Exclude necessary conflict avoidance, law compliance and police/device direction before a deterministic expectation.
